promotion_rule: Only evidence files whose row verification_state is verified, promotion_eligible is true, and all three target fields are source_verified may create a canonical turnout observation.

current_tranche.materialization_note: This tranche adds Bahati (174), Emurua Dikirr (178), Narok East (180) and Kajiado West (186), independently source-verified in the p23-turnout-tranche-a session against freshly downloaded, sha256-confirmed official IEBC Form 34B PDFs (form_id = constituency_code + 277628, with the portal session first reset from its default 2022-2027 by-election context to the 2022 general election via index.php?r=common/set-election&id=5). Each row was read directly from a clearly legible TOTAL row and reconciles exactly to the existing governed 2022 registered-voter denominator and to the four-candidate valid-vote breakdown on the same row. Emurua Dikirr's official upload is a CamScanner phone-photo scan (visible page curvature and binder-hole shadows) rather than a flatbed scan, but the printed table remained fully legible and was independently cross-checked with a 500 DPI crop. Seven constituencies reviewed in the same batch were withheld rather than forced through, for two distinct reasons: (a) the same genuine prison/special-polling-station denominator-gap pattern already confirmed for Keiyo North, Emgwen, Baringo Central, Eldama Ravine, Laikipia West, Laikipia East and Naivasha -- Nakuru Town West (175, 181-voter gap matching Nakuru Main + Nakuru Women), Kilgoris (177, 12-voter gap matching Kilgoris Prison), Narok North (179, 56-voter gap matching Narok Prison), Kajiado Central (184, 43-voter gap matching Kajiado Prison), and Kajiado South (187, 3-voter gap matching Loitokitok GK Prison); and (b) a newly observed pattern where a printed TOTAL row's Rejected Ballots cell is genuinely missing rather than merely hard to read -- Narok South (181, whose official scan crops off the entire Rejected Ballots table column at the page's right margin, on every page of the form, not only the TOTAL row) and Kajiado East (185, whose printed TOTAL row leaves the Rejected Ballots cell completely blank while every other cell on the same row, including Registered Voters and Total Valid Votes, is filled in). In both category-(b) cases the candidate cells sum exactly to Total Valid Votes and registered voters matches the governed denominator, but rejected_ballots cannot be sourced, so promotion is blocked by the extraction contract's requirement that all three fields be source_verified.

canonical_rebuild_sync.note: The canonical full-build output was synchronized after deterministic rebuild drift was detected. This audit metadata does not authorize any additional geography or value promotion.

invariants: No county, ward, media, citizen-tally or candidate-party value is inherited or substituted.
OCR consensus is never sufficient for promotion without a separate source-image verification record.
Registered voters must reconcile exactly to the existing governed P23 constituency voter denominator.
Total valid votes plus rejected ballots must not exceed registered voters.
Turnout must be derived only from the three verified source integers and remain in [0,100].
An unresolved or unreadable constituency remains in the 290-row audit and creates no canonical series or observation.
Adding further verified evidence files may only reduce existing P23 turnout slots; it may not create new governed slots.
Arithmetic-mismatch rows remain promotion-blocked even when their component integers are source-verified.

scale_plan.next_step: Continue independent official Form 34B source review or governed closure for the remaining P23 turnout rows; preserve all arithmetic conflicts, incomplete rows and ambiguous TOTAL labels without inference.
